decisions.reason: A hyaluronic serum is a low-cost, standard facial-care item that fits the firm's small-batch in-house production, and with no visible shortfall against aspirations the satisficing choice is to keep it, though its modest prominence leaves some risk after the aloe line was pruned.

The cleansing milk is a basic staple of a natural facial routine that uses existing suppliers and capabilities, and without a signal of underperformance there is no trigger for problemistic search, although the newer cleansing oil could partly cannibalize it.

The cleansing oil was launched only in 2024, so its results are still uncertain, and the small firm's growing industry gives it enough slack to carry the product until performance can be judged against aspirations.
